description:
Returns a [paginated](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/intro/#pagination) list of statuses that match a search on name or project.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:**

 *  *Administer projects* [project permission.](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg)
 *  *Administer Jira* [project permission.](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg)

parameters.description: The project the status is part of or null for global statuses.
parameters.name: projectId

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: Term to match status names against or null to search for all statuses in the search scope.
parameters.name: searchString

parameters.description: Category of the status to filter by. The supported values are: `TODO`, `IN_PROGRESS`, and `DONE`.
parameters.name: statusCategory

parameters.description: Whether to include global statuses (scope = null, not tied to any project) in the response. Defaults to false. Only relevant for project scoped queries.
parameters.name: includeGlobalStatuses

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing, or the caller doesn't have permissions to perform the operation.
